data.description: Round, looped armrests in black steel give the Maestro Bench a more traditional look than our straight-legged benches. The seat and backrest are wooden slats, and each end frame curls into a ring that forms the armrest before opening into two curved feet. The design sits well in heritage-style campuses, temple gardens, hotel lawns and older society gardens where a very plain bench would look out of place. The armrests also help elderly users sit down and stand up. It is listed in Sand Beige within our CoreCraft garden decor range. Length, seating and warranty terms are confirmed with the quote. Share a photo of your garden and we will suggest where the benches should go.

items.pText: Round, looped armrests in black steel give the Maestro Bench a more traditional look than our straight-legged benches. The seat and backrest are wooden slats, and each end frame curls into a ring that forms the armrest before opening into two curved feet. The design sits well in heritage-style campuses, temple gardens, hotel lawns and older society gardens where a very plain bench would look out of place. The armrests also help elderly users sit down and stand up. It is listed in Sand Beige within our CoreCraft garden decor range. Length, seating and warranty terms are confirmed with the quote. Share a photo of your garden and we will suggest where the benches should go.

Each end frame stands on two curved feet, which we fix self-standing on paving or grout into soil. Check the slat screws and the bolts joining the slats to the armrest rings during maintenance. Clear wet leaves from the slats after rain so the wood dries out quickly, and touch up any chipped paint on the steel.
